title: ListIdentity request and response-item parsing
purpose: Cover discovery request handling and bidirectional Common Packet Format parsing with the documented List Identity Response Item type.

messages.label: ListIdentity response with List Identity Response Item

expected_behavior: The server recognizes the ListIdentity command; the response CPF contains one item with type 0x000c and a zero-length data field, allowing response-item framing and length handling to be exercised.
constraints_preserved: The response payload length is 6 bytes, matching the CPF count and one four-byte item header
CPF item type 0x000c is the documented List Identity Response Item
All multi-byte encapsulation and CPF fields use little-endian encoding
Hex strings contain complete byte pairs without separators
issue_safety_notes: No issue evidence is enabled. The zero-length response item is a minimal structural parser seed and makes no claim about a complete device identity response.
